counts_note: creatures = species rows in pokemons-data.csv; classes = synergy (type) names; weapons = wand items; gear_sets = 0 because the box has no armour sets (item families are in gear_tiers); zones = dungeon map entries in Dungeon.ts (11 scripted PvE stages and 13 weather states are listed separately in zones).
creature_families: Rarity ladder of nine categories sets the shop cost (config/game/shop.ts line 20).
Evolution lines of 1 to 4 stages; most are 3-stage lines (671 rows at 3 stages, 429 at 2, 40 at 4, 35 at 1).
Types: 31 distinct, largest psychic (151), normal (148), water (132), field (131), flying (124); smallest baby (22), fossil (48).
532 distinct families in the Family column of app/models/precomputed/pokemons-data.csv (names not reproduced).

Boss pattern: scripted PvE stages in app/models/pve-stages.ts (11 stages): two-unit opener, three-unit row boss with HP +100 boost (line 192), four-unit finale with one unit on another row and stat boosts plus four held-item slots (line 333).

top_creatures.label: Trio vanguard encounter
top_creatures.why: A three-unit row boss with a shared stat boost; should read as one group at a glance (judgement, not measured at 375 wide).
top_creatures.keep: Fixed row line-up plus boss stat table as data.
top_creatures.change: Our creatures, our names, a different formation.

top_creatures.label: Four-unit finale with an off-row leader
top_creatures.why: The unit on the second row makes the finale read as a leader.
top_creatures.keep: Leader placed on a separate row.

top_creatures.label: Ember stacker
top_creatures.why: Attack climbs on every landed hit, so a fight visibly escalates.
top_creatures.change: Add a cap; the class body read has none. Use our heat-ribbon look.

top_creatures.label: Kill-growth beast
top_creatures.why: Each kill grows attack and ability power by tier; the class also tracks a boosted-HP amount.
top_creatures.change: Cap it per fight and tie it to our hate list.

top_creatures.label: Last-stand surge
top_creatures.why: One-shot surge below 30 per cent HP (+40 speed, +40 per cent base attack, +30 shield), reverted after 3000 ms by a delayed command.
top_creatures.keep: One-shot threshold trigger and a timed revert.
top_creatures.change: The revert block undoes speed and attack but not the shield; treat that as a defect and decay the shield too.
top_creatures.ref: app/core/effects/synergies.ts lines 453-476 (addShield line 458, revert delay line 471)

top_creatures.label: Focus lifesteal healer
top_creatures.why: Lifesteal fraction set by which self-buff is present (25, 35 or 50 per cent, checked in code order); skips retaliation and self-damage.
top_creatures.keep: Gating lifesteal by a self-buff; the retaliation exclusion.
top_creatures.ref: app/core/effects/synergies.ts lines 249-265 (retaliation check line 251, rate line 255)

top_creatures.label: Three-copy merge evolver
top_creatures.why: A line grows into its next stage when enough copies stand on the board; a held item blocks one copy from counting.
top_creatures.keep: Merge-by-count evolution and the held-item blocker.
top_creatures.change: Our item name and our count.

top_creatures.label: Shiny variant creature
top_creatures.why: The shiny flag picks a separate animation set per tint, with a per-species opt-out (shinyUnavailable).
top_creatures.keep: Flag-selected art set and a per-species opt-out.
top_creatures.change: Our variant is a shader glow on the same art, not a second art set.

weapon_families: Wands: 16 items, each a distinct on-hit or on-cast effect (app/types/enum/Item.ts lines 926-944); one slot, many effects.

Pounce wand: on a crit or a 10 per cent chance, a splash of 30 per cent of the incoming hit, then a cooldown field set to 250 (unit not checked) (app/core/effects/synergies.ts lines 795-812; the first 18 lines read, splash target not read).
gear_tiers: Metal ladder of technical items: bronze, silver, gold, four each (app/types/enum/Item.ts lines 952-972).
Shiny (gold-themed) held items: 12 (ShinyItems, Item.ts line 645); a separate item-cell class (item-container.ts line 76).
Synergy gems (30; Item.ts lines 712-745), memory discs (26; lines 367-395), keyed to traits.
Crafted stones from two base components: 55 recipe keys (ItemRecipe, Item.ts lines 507-564).
Dishes (46) and berries (24) as consumable families (Item.ts lines 571-600, 994-1042).
zones: Dungeon map catalogue: 143 entries in one enum (app/types/enum/Dungeon.ts lines 160-305), music enum at line 1; loading skips the town map (app/public/src/game/components/loading-manager.ts line 122).

Procedural terrain: fractal noise into three cells, wall above 0.66, ground above 0.33, water below (app/core/design.ts lines 84-101). Defect: the seed is not passed to Terrain (app/core/terrain.ts lines 31-33; seed read at line 180), so maps are not reproducible; fix by passing a zone seed.
Weather: 13 states (app/types/enum/Weather.ts line 6); trait-to-weather map (lines 50-66); weather-to-passive map (lines 37-48).
Expeditions: 4 types by 6 ranks (app/types/enum/Expedition.ts lines 7-20); offer hash deterministic per player and count (line 26).
Scripted PvE stage table: 11 stages (app/models/pve-stages.ts lines 42-360).

looks.label: Shiny art set per tint
looks.technique: A separate animation set chosen by one boolean, with a per-species opt-out.

looks.label: Shine sparkle on reward drop
looks.technique: A looping sparkle sprite plus a tween that rises 48 px and spreads items 70 px apart (layout values).

looks.label: Two animation frame rates
looks.technique: Character animation at 36 fps and effects at 20 fps, as separate constants.

looks.label: Region tint with colour-blind switch
looks.technique: A per-region tint applied to board sprites, with an accessibility option.

looks.label: Status and emotion vocabulary
looks.technique: 29 status values for icons and 20 emotions for idle and pose variety.

originals.name: Last Ember Surge
originals.idea: A once-per-fight burst below 30 per cent HP: speed, attack and a shield, reverting after a set time.
originals.keep: One-shot threshold trigger and a timed revert.
originals.change: The shield also decays; our numbers; an ember aura shader, not any donor visual.

originals.name: Trio Vanguard boss
originals.idea: Three units on a row sharing one boss stat table, with a leader on a second row.
originals.change: Our creatures, formation and names; no species.

originals.name: Kill Ledger beast
originals.idea: Each kill raises attack and max HP, capped per fight.
originals.change: A hard cap and a visible tally.

originals.name: Brood Line evolution
originals.idea: Three copies merge into the next stage carrying permanent stats; an anchor item blocks one copy.

originals.name: Focus Drinker lifesteal
originals.idea: Lifesteal of 25, 35 or 50 per cent set by a self-buff; retaliation and self-damage excluded.

originals.name: Trait Weather Pairs
originals.idea: Each trait is paired with a weather state that also adds a passive.
originals.change: Our traits and our weather set.

originals.name: Seeded Cut Terrain
originals.idea: Three cell types from one noise field with thresholds, reproducible from a zone seed.
originals.change: Fix the seed plumbing (the donor defect); our biome names.

originals.name: Shine Drop
originals.idea: A reward rises with a sparkle and a tween on the reward ceremony step.
originals.change: Our glow shader and loot-row timing.
